applications_v2_required_ck.name: applications_v2_required_ck
applications_v2_required_ck.value:
"applications"."schema_version" = 1 OR (
    "applications"."nisn" IS NOT NULL AND "applications"."birth_place" IS NOT NULL AND "applications"."birth_date" IS NOT NULL
    AND "applications"."gender" IS NOT NULL AND "applications"."address" IS NOT NULL AND "applications"."parent_name" IS NOT NULL
    AND "applications"."phone" IS NOT NULL AND "applications"."email" IS NOT NULL AND "applications"."academic_year" IS NOT NULL
    AND "applications"."document_requirements" IS NOT NULL)

applications_v2_values_ck.name: applications_v2_values_ck
applications_v2_values_ck.value:
"applications"."schema_version" = 1 OR (
    "applications"."registration_number" ~ '^NH-[A-Z0-9-]+$' AND "applications"."nisn" ~ '^[0-9]{10}$'
    AND length(btrim("applications"."student_name")) BETWEEN 2 AND 120 AND length(btrim("applications"."origin_school")) BETWEEN 2 AND 160
    AND length(btrim("applications"."birth_place")) BETWEEN 2 AND 100 AND "applications"."gender" IN ('Laki-laki', 'Perempuan')
    AND length(btrim("applications"."address")) BETWEEN 1 AND 600 AND length(btrim("applications"."parent_name")) BETWEEN 2 AND 120
    AND "applications"."phone" ~ '^[+]?[0-9 ]{8,20}$' AND position('@' in "applications"."email") > 1
    AND ("applications"."notes" IS NULL OR length("applications"."notes") <= 1000)
    AND nh_valid_document_requirements("applications"."document_requirements"))

submission_requests_state_ck.name: submission_requests_state_ck
submission_requests_state_ck.value: ("submission_requests"."state" = 'processing' AND "submission_requests"."application_id" IS NULL AND "submission_requests"."receipt" IS NULL) OR ("submission_requests"."state" = 'completed' AND "submission_requests"."application_id" IS NOT NULL AND "submission_requests"."receipt" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("submission_requests"."receipt") = 'object')

document_slots_presence_ck.name: document_slots_presence_ck
document_slots_presence_ck.value: ("application_document_slots"."status" = 'missing' AND "application_document_slots"."current_version_id" IS NULL AND NOT "application_document_slots"."received_physically") OR ("application_document_slots"."status" <> 'missing' AND ("application_document_slots"."current_version_id" IS NOT NULL OR "application_document_slots"."received_physically"))

application_documents_v2_file_ck.name: application_documents_v2_file_ck
application_documents_v2_file_ck.value: "application_documents"."schema_version" = 1 OR ("application_documents"."file_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880 AND "application_documents"."mime_type" IN ('application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'image/png') AND length(btrim("application_documents"."original_name")) > 0 AND length(btrim("application_documents"."storage_key")) > 0)

document_reviews_status_ck.name: document_reviews_status_ck
document_reviews_status_ck.value: "document_reviews"."status" <> 'missing' AND ("document_reviews"."version_id" IS NOT NULL OR "document_reviews"."received_physically") AND ("document_reviews"."status" <> 'needs_correction' OR length(btrim("document_reviews"."note")) > 0)

school_settings_dates_ck.name: school_settings_dates_ck
school_settings_dates_ck.value: "school_settings"."registration_opens_at" IS NULL OR "school_settings"."registration_closes_at" IS NULL OR "school_settings"."registration_closes_at" > "school_settings"."registration_opens_at"

school_settings_text_ck.name: school_settings_text_ck
school_settings_text_ck.value: length(btrim("school_settings"."school_name")) >= 2 AND length(btrim("school_settings"."tagline")) >= 2 AND length(btrim("school_settings"."address")) >= 10 AND length("school_settings"."phone") >= 8 AND length("school_settings"."whatsapp") >= 8

school_leaders_text_ck.name: school_leaders_text_ck
school_leaders_text_ck.value: length(btrim("school_leaders"."name")) >= 2 AND length(btrim("school_leaders"."role")) >= 2 AND length(btrim("school_leaders"."initials")) >= 1 AND length(btrim("school_leaders"."focus")) >= 2

teachers_values_ck.name: teachers_values_ck
teachers_values_ck.value: "teachers"."years" BETWEEN 0 AND 60 AND "teachers"."portrait_index" BETWEEN 0 AND 7 AND "teachers"."sort_order" >= 0

teachers_text_ck.name: teachers_text_ck
teachers_text_ck.value: length(btrim("teachers"."name")) >= 2 AND length(btrim("teachers"."initials")) >= 1 AND length(btrim("teachers"."subject")) >= 2 AND length(btrim("teachers"."note")) >= 2

applicant_accounts_activation_ck.name: applicant_accounts_activation_ck
applicant_accounts_activation_ck.value: "applicant_accounts"."activated_at" IS NULL OR "applicant_accounts"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL
